items.reason: R2 change rendered source "Starbuck looked, and lo!" as "Starbuck looked, and — look! —", a doubled word (looked/look!) that reads as a slip. Source "as infallibly going West" fix is otherwise correct. Replace "look!" with "behold!".
items.new: Thrusting his head halfway into the binnacle, Ahab caught one glimpse of the compasses; his uplifted arm slowly fell; for a moment he almost seemed to stagger. Standing behind him, Starbuck looked, and — behold! — the two compasses pointed east, and the Pequod was just as unerringly going west.
